description: Figure 8 presents a line chart comparing the accuracy of two experimental runs, Ex1 and Ex2, during the Embedding and LM Head training stage. The x-axis, labeled "Step," is a linear scale ranging from 0 to 60000, with major tick marks at intervals of 10000. The y-axis, labeled "Accuracy (Next Token Prediction)," is a linear scale ranging from 0.10 to 0.40, with major tick marks at intervals of 0.05. The chart displays two lines: a solid blue line representing "Ex1 Accuracy" and a dashed green line representing "Ex2 Accuracy." Both lines show a sharp increase in accuracy from the start of training. The "Ex1 Accuracy" line begins at approximately 0.25 and rises to a plateau near 0.40 after about 10000 steps. The "Ex2 Accuracy" line starts at a lower value of approximately 0.26, rises more steeply, and reaches a plateau at a lower level of approximately 0.38 after about 15000 steps.
